english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the First Man and the Ambassador and the Ship; what they resemble.
english_classification.chapter_note: A collection of five cosmic parables/similes mapping redemption processes within the cosmic system. Gardner notes the original contexts are lost and these were assembled during transmission. Teaching purity is 1.000 with zero editorial fatigue—the substrate dominates almost completely. Each parable maps a cosmic agent (First Man, Great Spirit, Living Spirit, Ambassador) to a simile figure, with both sides staying within the cosmic system. The only non-substrate material is the final paragraph (¶6), which pivots to exhortation/application directed at the audience. The 'Once again' markers at the head of each parable are minimal editorial collection markers, easily stripped to reveal the teaching underneath. The systematic structure (parable → cosmic referent) is Persian pedagogical tradition: teaching through analogy within the cosmic architecture.
